short: Icon and its closed registry of shapes
is: `Icon.svelte`, which draws one named icon as inline SVG, and `icons.ts`, the closed registry: 46 Lucide icons copied as shape data so they ship inline and self-hosted, the name list, the `isIconName` predicate and the two stroke weights.
conventions: The registry is closed. An `IconName` is one of the listed names and a string is checked with `isIconName`; nothing is fetched and no icon is injected as markup.

Icon draws and does nothing else: it takes a `name`, a `size` (the three icon size tokens) and a `weight` (regular, or heavy for the checkmark inside a checked control), and is hidden from assistive technology; a control that needs a name gives it a label of its own.
To add an icon, add its shapes and its name together; the licence note stays at the top of `icons.ts`.

fs.name: Icon.svelte
fs.role: draws one icon from the registry at a size token and a stroke weight
